prerequisites: Basic of physic at the high school level
Basic of chemistry at the high school level

learning_outcomes.text: Know basic types and properties of materials
Know influence of basic manufacturing technoilogies on the basic materials properties
Know basic types and properties iron alloys structures
Able to assess the type of materials applied for engineering design
Can determine the structures of materials applied for engineering design
Can determine the basic properties of materials applied for engineering design
Information retrieval and their critical analyse
Observance of custom and rules binding at academic environment

syllabus_topics: Classification of engineering materials. Relations between manufacturing processes, structures and properties of materials
Mechanical and physical properties of materials and methods of their determination. The rules of materials selection at machine building
Polymer materials - classification, structures, properties
Ceramic and glass materials - classification, structures, properties
Composite materials - classification, manufacturing methods, properties
Metals reinforcement methods. Classification and method of metals formation
Elements of crystallography. Build of real crystals. Defects of crystalline structures
Equilibrium and criterion of equilibrium. Internal energy. Entropy, Free energy
Phase transformation, Crystallisation. Allotropic and magnetic transformation
Plastical deformation and recrystallisation
Alloys. Build and types of alloys. Intermetallic phases
Characteristic of phases presented in alloys of metals
Phase equilibrium diagrams of binary systems. Phase rule.
Analyse basic types of phase equilibrium diagrams
Iron-cementite equilibrium diagram. Analysis of diagram
Introduction. The aim and methods materials investigation. Construction and maintenance of metallographic microscope
Macroscopic investigations, analyse of fracture surfaces, macrostructures of materials and technological origin defects
Macroscopic and microscopic investigation of composite materials
Analyse of equilibrium binary system diagrams
Investigation of microstructures of mono and multiphase alloys at etched and non-etched state
Analyse of iron-cementite phase equilibrium diagram
Analyse microstructures of iron-cementite diagram
Summary and credit of laboratory practice
teaching_methods: traditional lecture with the use of transparencies and slides
self study - self studies and preparation for examination
self study - preparation for laboratory class
assessment_rules: Evaluation of lecture educational effects achievement is based on a written-oral examination. Evaluation of laboratory educational effects achievement is based on an introduction test, oral answers, and a report.
bibliography: M. F. Ashby- Materials Selection in Mechanical Design
degree: Mechanical Engineering and Machine Building (I level, full-time)
